honest_assessment: The from-scratch pipeline is verified end to end: correct next-token alignment, hand-derived gradients matching finite differences with non-unit layernorm scales, deterministic checkpoint reload (full logits), and reproducible resume (model + optimizer + sampler RNG). Held-out loss decreased. HOWEVER: this model is tiny (13992 parameters, ~2.5 KB corpus) and its samples are NOT fluent English. It has not learned English in any meaningful sense; it has only learned coarse character statistics of a tiny corpus. Fluency was not achieved in this experiment.
